answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 51260 Country: India Title: Dua or zikr before giving birth to a baby. Question: Is there any dua or zikr before giving birth to a baby or before delivery? Answer ID: 51260 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 544/444/B=04/1435) Generally labour pain is so acute that causes a woman to forget dua or zikr. However, if a woman is in better condition, she can do dua or zikr. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
